newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bank of Israel resumes monetary tenders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Israel resumes monetary tenders.

text.p: The Bank of Israel on Tuesday held its first monetary tender to commercial banks since cancelling its tender on September 2.
The central bank had said on September 2 it would not hold another tender until further notice because of excess liquidity in the system.
The tender is for daily loans to commercial banks.
A central bank spokesman said the daily tenders would continue in the coming days but that the situation was continuously being monitored.
In August the central bank cancelled seven such tenders because of surplus liquidity and in July the weekly tenders to commercial banks were cancelled.
The central bank had said the excess liquidity was a result of high government expenditure.
